market_cutoff.rule: Do not backdate rendered observations. Use publisher timestamps where available; otherwise retain retrieval-time uncertainty.

semantics.ticker_open: UTC-day open, not a rolling 24-hour open
semantics.ticker_volume: 24-hour volume is the second volume element
semantics.ticker_vwap: 24-hour VWAP is the second VWAP element
semantics.best_quote_sizes: Displayed top-of-book sizes only; not full order-book depth or consolidated liquidity

ineligibility_reasons: Original HTTP bytes and response headers not captured
Single-venue ticker is not consolidated order-book depth

coverage.source_method: TradRadar says it collects exchange data and aggregates it across the listed venues

ineligibility_reasons: Rendered aggregate page rather than original venue payloads
Venue-specific raw event timestamps and contract normalization not independently captured

cryptokeyhole_xrp_etf_flows.methodology: Issuer-reported holdings deltas; the site states its USD valuation uses its own XRP/USD close. The displayed partial-day zero is not a complete fund-universe total.
ineligibility_reasons: Only four funds are collected in this source universe
Holdings deltas are not direct AP cash creation/redemption records

xrp_insights_etf_flows.fund_universe: Six US spot XRP funds plus BITW
xrp_insights_etf_flows.method: Day-over-day changes in issuer-reported XRP holdings; flow-excluded funds count as zero under the publisher's stated methodology.
xrp_insights_etf_flows.independence_note: Shares issuer disclosures with CryptoKeyhole; these two aggregators are not independent primary confirmations.
ineligibility_reasons: Holdings deltas are not direct AP cash records
Publisher methodology includes flow-excluded funds as zero

reported_context: Global AI-related equity selloff and safe-haven demand supported the US dollar
Lower US Treasury yields capped the dollar's gains
Two-year Treasury yield fell about 10 basis points to its lowest since September 10
Ten-year Treasury yield fell nearly 6 basis points
Dollar index was reported up 0.25% at 101.76
Japanese yen reached 157.27 per dollar before trading around 157.805
Investors were awaiting the US October nonfarm payrolls report
Reuters described market attention to US midterm-election implications for AI, tariffs and the US-Israeli war with Iran
ineligibility_reasons: Qualitative macro context, not an XRP-specific causal measurement
No estimated XRP beta or event-study result attached

bls_upcoming_event.vintage_rule: Store initial release, each later revision and source publication time as separate vintages.

groups.note: One aggregator over seven derivatives venues; do not count its venue rows as seven independent source publishers.
Different universe and methodology, but shares issuer source documents with subset A.
Independent macro reporting; no direct XRP causal attribution.

explicit_non_independence: CryptoKeyhole and XRP Insights both derive ETF holdings from issuer-published data; their agreement is not two independent issuer confirmations.
TradRadar's seven exchange rows are constituents of one aggregated provider publication, not seven independent published sources.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: A leveraged-long unwind is contributing to the current XRP decline.
supporting_evidence: TradRadar reports price down 8.82% over 24 hours and USD open interest down 8.45%
TradRadar reports at least $16.71M long liquidations versus $0.43304M short liquidations
Funding remains positive and its account-count sample is approximately 79.9% long
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: The data is an aggregator snapshot with a 15-minute display delay
USD-notional OI can fall partly because mark price falls
Long/short account share is not notional positioning
Liquidations are a lower bound and venue coverage is incomplete

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Broader global risk-off conditions are contributing to XRP weakness.
supporting_evidence: Reuters reports a global AI-related equity selloff and safe-haven demand
Reuters reports falling Treasury yields and competing currency effects ahead of US payrolls
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: No synchronized XRP/BTC/equity/yield event study is attached
Reuters does not attribute XRP price movement to these macro factors
Falling Treasury yields may offset part of the dollar safe-haven impulse

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: ETF holdings reductions may contribute marginal XRP supply.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights reports -259701 XRP across its Nov2-Nov4 settled window
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: CryptoKeyhole reports only a partial Nov5 universe of 2/4 funds
Holdings deltas are not direct AP cash creations/redemptions
The settled flow window is earlier than the price observation and is not synchronized
ETF aggregators share issuer sources and are not independent primary confirmations

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-provider timing and coverage differences explain part of the apparent spot/derivatives disagreement.
supporting_evidence: Kraken API response has no provider event timestamp
TradRadar page is explicitly delayed by 15 minutes
The Kraken last trade and TradRadar mark are from different venue universes and observation times
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: Timing differences do not explain away the independently reported direction of the selloff
Synchronized venue-level raw trades and contract-level OI history are still missing

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The displayed Kraken top-of-book is close to the session low but does not establish broad-market liquidity depth.
supporting_evidence: Kraken last is 0.022841% above its reported 24-hour low
Ticker reports only 90 XRP at the best ask and 454 XRP at the best bid
Spread is narrow at approximately 0.084576 basis points
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: Ticker quote sizes are not a full depth snapshot
A single venue cannot establish consolidated liquidity or cancellation-adjusted depth
No synchronized multi-venue L2 order-book capture is included

forecast.reason: This capture lacks synchronized raw multi-venue data, complete ETF cash-flow records, an independently timestamped Kraken event, and evaluator-attested out-of-sample lift and calibration. Market interpretation is not a forecast.

next_tests: Capture byte-complete Kraken and other venue REST/WebSocket payloads with provider timestamps, receipt timestamps and SHA-256 receipts.
Collect synchronized L2 snapshots and cancellation-aware depth across venues.
Reconcile contract-level open interest and funding from each venue rather than relying only on a third-party aggregate.
Wait for all ETF issuer files and reconcile holdings, shares, NAV and AP cash creations/redemptions as separate fields.
Ingest the BLS October Employment Situation initial release at its actual publication time and preserve subsequent revisions as new vintages.
Run an event study against BTC, broad crypto market returns, DXY, Treasury yields and equity indices before assigning macro causality.

model_eligibility.reason: Rendered and asynchronous source observations are useful for research triage but do not meet the point-in-time raw-receipt admission contract.
